{{Quote|I laced herds of wooly thookahs with the herb so those who ate them would immediately become peaceful. I planned on spreading it throughout the galaxy, making all peoples peace-loving and harmless. What more could any Ithorian want?|Zorneth's journal|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>}}
The '''thookah''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal that had shaggy fur. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Zorneth]] fed thookah the [[savorium herb]]. Thookah steaks then had the same properties as the drug itself. The first batch of thookah meat was fed to the [[Krozurbian War Council]]. They subsequently embraced peace, ending two hundred years of [[Krozurbian war|warfare]].
